text: Vista Global's founder and chairman Thomas Flohr held an 84% stake in the company when Bloomberg reported in April 2024 that he was open to selling part of it; Flohr later told CNBC, 'I will always keep the majority of the company.' In March 2025 Vista Global agreed a $600 million equity investment led by RRJ Capital, with Andalusian Private Capital, joining the company's existing investor base.
short: Thomas Flohr founded Vista Global, held 84% and says he will keep the majority

source.quote: In April, Bloomberg reported that he was open to selling part of his 84% stake in the company to raise equity.
